description: Bike3S is a simulator for station-based bike-sharing systems described in a 2024 arXiv preprint by Alberto Fernández, Holger Billhardt, Sascha Ossowski and Óscar Sánchez. It runs semi-realistic simulations of how a system operates so that strategic and operational decisions, such as fleet size, station capacities, the distribution of stations and balancing strategies, can be evaluated before they are deployed. It is a microscopic agent-based simulator: users of different types can be defined, each acting on its own goals, and their decisions drive the dynamics of the whole system. Coverage: generic station-based systems. Format and access: the preprint; a public code release was not confirmed during this pass. Licence and cost: the preprint is on arXiv; software terms were not stated and should be asked of the authors. Caveats: the abstract gives no validation or case city, and the authors' affiliation was not read. It supports agent-based, capacity planning and optimisation studies of bike sharing. It relates to FOMOsim and the BSS dynamic rebalancing simulator in the catalogue.
